title: Asn
description:
Autonomous System Number details for the IP. Free plans receive `as_number`,
`organization`, and `country` only. Paid plans also receive `type`, `domain`,
`date_allocated`, and `rir`.

organization.description: Name of the organization that owns the ASN.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country where the ASN is registered.

type.description:
Organization type. Values: `ISP`, `HOSTING`, `BUSINESS`, `EDUCATION`,
`GOVERNMENT`. Paid plans only.

domain.description: Primary domain of the ASN holder. Paid plans only.

date_allocated.description:
Date when the ASN was allocated, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (e.g.
`2024-12-13`). Paid plans only.

rir.description: Regional Internet Registry (RIR) that allocated the ASN. Possible values include `RIPE`, `ARIN`, `APNIC`, `LACNIC`, `AFRINIC`, etc.
